# Northwind Ceramics positioning

FIXTURE PAGE — a fictional company, standing in for a CUSTOMER's second brain. It lives at

## Who we sell to

Independent kitchen studios with two to six showrooms, never the national chains. The chains buy on
unit price and we lose those on purpose. A studio owner buys a glaze because a customer walked in,
touched a tile, and asked for it by name.

## Recorded decision — we do not sell through distributors

The CEO settled this in the spring. A distributor takes the relationship, then commoditizes the
catalogue, then asks for a private label. We ship direct, we eat the logistics cost, and we keep the
studio owner's phone number. Revisit only if direct shipping stops being viable in a region.

## Hard rule — never quote a lead time we have not confirmed with the kiln

Two orders were lost by promising six weeks while the kiln was booked for nine. Every quoted lead
time is confirmed against the kiln schedule before it reaches a customer, without exception.
